units.source_text: 匂亲王写了一封缠绵悱恻的情书来。

en.t: Prince Niou sent her a deeply passionate and sorrowful love letter.

units.source_text: 浮舟现在不想再教人看到她的书札，所以连回信也不肯随意写一封，只写了一首诗：

en.t: Ukifune now did not want anyone to see her letters, so she would not casually write even a reply, and instead wrote only one poem:
